description: Fetch Coupon. The "Get Coupon Details" API enables you to retrieve comprehensive information about a specific coupon using either its unique identifier or promotional code. Use this endpoint to view coupon parameters, usage statistics, validity periods, and other promotional details.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_getCoupon
